creative_direction: Paint Naruto Uzumaki in an orange everyday jacket with a short light scarf, preserving his blond spikes and cheek marks. He lightly holds the scarf at one side and looks toward the viewer with a calm optimistic smile. Keep the pose ordinary and the shoulders relaxed. Use cool evening-blue washes with a restrained warm edge around the pale moon. Use varied ink line weight, light pigment washes, and generous negative space. Use muted rose-violet irises with fine concentric rings, visible pupils, and clear highlights. Place a pale moon disc behind the character; keep the mood gentle and unthreatening. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
